classification.resume: This document is a parliamentary record of a session in the Swiss National Council (Nationalrat) from the spring session of 1984, containing a petition concerning Swiss nationals missing in Argentina and submitted by the Association internationale contre la torture (Geneva). The record includes speakers Pierre Aubert, Françoise Pitteloud, and Sigmund Widmer during the debate. It is an audio recording of the proceedings.
